title: Approve Utu's native app shell
question: These are three states of one installed app: Attention, Projects, and Fleet. Approve the set or use the note field to name what still feels wrong.

options.label: Unified native workspace
options.lineage: Buzz-like fixed shell, Grok Bot-like focus
options.thesis: One compact app shell preserves context while Attention, Projects, and Fleet each center the work appropriate to that view.
options.viewport: Attention opens as an owner inbox; Projects as a living project work stream; Fleet as an agent session and roster—all with the same rails and direct-control composer.
options.risk: The generated screens vary slightly in rail details; implementation must normalize them into one exact shell rather than reproducing those inconsistencies.
